source_grounded_boundary: Local fallback is extractive and query-aware. Hosted/compiler documentation also describes intentionally lossy JSON/code/log preprocessing. CCR can retrieve removed originals, but hosted persistence is owner-scoped Firestore with finite TTL and must not become a second F2 truth store. Optional BGE reranking adds model/runtime identity requirements.
strongest_positive: A deterministic extractive selector with canonical-source retrieval references can plausibly shrink bounded ContextViews while preserving one canonical authority.
strongest_counterevidence: Immediate-query relevance is not equivalent to F2 evidence-obligation completeness; lossy preprocessing may delete contradiction, UNKNOWN, authority, temporal or causal evidence needed later.
next_gate: Acquire a new E3 atomic claim, then run a local no-provider adversarial context fixture measuring mandatory-evidence recall, byte-exact extractive retention, canonical-reference resolvability, deterministic repeat identity, query-switch recoverability and latency/token savings.
